results.name: Runs opens with Ctrl+2 and shows the project
Describe a task: the agent plans without changing anything
The timeline links a step to what it produced
Comment on the plan, send feedback, get revision 2
Approve with a scope: the dialog says exactly what is allowed
Changes were made in the worktree only, and the tests ran
The Review queue lists it; apply keeps your uncommitted work
A destructive command asks, and Deny from the Review queue stops it
Restart mid-run: ORBIX is killed while a command runs
After the restart the run, its plan and its log are there, marked interrupted
Resume needs your OK for the action whose outcome is unknown
A conflict is refused and leaves both sides as they were
No errors in the page console
